name: Python Code Review
description: Review Python files for coding standards and best practices.
prompt: Review the recently saved Python file. Check for PEP 8 compliance, FastAPI best practices, async programming, type hints, exception handling, Pydantic validation, Beanie ODM usage, code readability, and maintainability. Suggest improvements without changing the overall functionality.

name: API Review
description: Validate FastAPI endpoints and API design.
prompt: Review this FastAPI API implementation. Verify endpoint naming, request and response models, HTTP status codes, validation, exception handling, route consistency, and REST API best practices.

name: Unit Test Review
description: Review unit tests for completeness and coverage.
prompt: Review the recently saved test file. Identify missing edge cases, validation scenarios, mocking improvements, assertion quality, and opportunities to improve test coverage.
